messages:
Priya Shah: FYI SolsticePay opened a ticket — they saw a sudden cluster of 429s this morning around 03:02-03:04 UTC. Reports say throughput didn't change on their side.
Alex Gomez: can you paste the top-line from our rate-limit headers for one of the failed requests? x-rpm / x-tpm etc.
Priya Shah: grabbing a curl from their logs now. headers look like: 
`x-rpm-limit: 1000` 
`x-rpm-remaining: 0` 
`x-tpm-limit: 60000` 
`x-tpm-remaining: 58000`
 so RPM hit, TPM fine.
Cheng Li: interesting — RPM exhausted but TPM fine. Is their traffic bursty at second granularity? ask for their client pattern.
Priya Shah: they sent back this snippet — a worker fanout that fires 120 jobs in the same second: 
```
for i in 1..120 do post /v1/generate ... &
end
```
Nina Morales: that explains RPM. Our per-minute rolling window is enforced on fixed 60s buckets, we do not smooth sub-minute bursts by default.
Alex Gomez: quick mitigation: tell them to add jitter and client-side concurrency cap to ~10-20 and exponential backoff. Also we can temporarily raise their RPM quota while they refactor. Nina, can infra do a 2x temporary bump?
Nina Morales: infra-bot note: I can escalate a short-lived increase (2x RPM for 1 hour) — need customer id and approval. pinged sales for emergency approve.
Priya Shah: gave customer the recommended client changes + asked if they want the temporary bump. they asked for repro help to validate after change.
Cheng Li: for repro, have them run a controlled load test: 100 requests spread uniformly across 60s vs 100 requests all at once. Compare `x-rpm-remaining` on responses. Example curl loop for uniform pace: 
```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{...}'; sleep 0.6; done
```

Alex Gomez: also include header dump to prove remaining counters. If they still see 429s on uniform pacing, escalate to infra to check token-scoped counters.
Priya Shah: customer will test uniform vs burst and report back. they asked if we have a client-side snippet to auto-smooth bursts.
Cheng Li: share this small JS queue + randomized delay: 
```js
const q = []; async function send(item){ await sleep( Math.random()*200 + 50 ); await fetch(...)}
// concurrency: 10
```
Nina Morales: sales approved short bump for 1 hour. infra-bot will apply, ETA 5m. I'll follow up.
Priya Shah: thanks — will update ticket. marking checklist: ask customer to test after bump, share smoothing code, and confirm long-term fix. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: temporary_rpm_increase applied to customer:solsticepay. new_rpm=2000 duration=3600s by Nina Morales.
Priya Shah: closing loop if their controlled test passes. will reopen if anything unexpected.
